mentions.name: Burst
mentions.description: This is an opinionated backup software written in Rust for performing weekly file backups. It was recently ported to use Tokio and is cross-platform, supporting Windows and macOS users.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Burst (https://github.com/fred1268/burst) my opinionated backup software written in Rust, non only to weekly backup my files but also to learn Rust. I recently ported it to use Tokio. Ah, and it's cross platform for the Windows or macOS users.
